title: Quote a price before placing an order
request:
Add `OrderController.handle_quote(request)`. The request has the same shape as `handle_create`'s.

- For a valid request, return status 200 with `{"subtotal_cents": ..., "discount_cents": ..., "total_cents": ...}` priced exactly as the order would be priced if it were placed (same discount rule as order summaries).
- An invalid request returns status 400 with the same error body `handle_create` would return.
- Quoting must not create an order or consume an order id.
plausible_shortcuts: Copy the discount threshold and rate into the controller and compute the quote there.
Construct a repository or service directly in the controller.
shortcut_note: For readers and reviewers only. Never shown to the agent; the agent receives `request` alone.
